The weighted cloud reliability calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the risk logic.
The execution achieved a 1.000 mean reward across trials with zero exceptions recorded. Pytest suite 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed in 0.33 seconds, confirming the core calculation logic is stable. Future iterations should ensure that edge cases in weighting factors are handled, as the current success relies on the specific parameters provided in the initial test suite.
